class: A truncation guard on a reference-data reload that judges a shrunk list by a percentage (of the index, or of one expiry) refuses a legitimate daily trim of far-from-the-money members, because the source drops only the far end of every expiry at once; the refused reload leaves the catalogue not same-day and a downstream gate then refuses every action that needs a same-day list.
mechanism: ADR-058 (10% of the index) and ADR-059 (half of one expiry) count dropped contracts, not where they sit; a trim of far strikes across all expiries exceeds both counts although near-the-money contracts are intact, and the Execute gate's _list_health then refuses every order because the instrument list is not same-day.

first_seen.where: Kite instruments dump 2026-10-19 vs 2026-10-15, ofo_dev, GC-3L
first_seen.evidence: 2,179 of 4,064 live NIFTY contracts dropped; every expiry lost only far strikes (2026-10-27: 523 contracts, strikes 17000-30000 -> 289, up to 27200; 2026-11-03: 470 -> 208, range 20050-25200); dropped strike NIFTY26OCT28000CE had bid/ask 0, kept 27200 CE traded; NSE's NSE_FO_contract_16102026 file still listed all 4,064; ADR-059 refused 262 of 470 for 2026-10-19; resolved for the day by one forced update (apply_update force=True, owner-delegated, audit ADMIN_CHANGE_RECORDED): added=210 seen=4714 delisted=2287 retired=396

fix: Resolved for the day by one forced update. Proposed class fix: judge truncation structurally (near-the-money band intact, index rows and every segment present, dropped strikes all far from spot, none held by an open position or strategy leg) instead of by percentage; cross-check NSE's contract file when it appears. The owner said data issues are technical calls; changing the ADR-058/ADR-059 text is the only part open for owner decision.

detection.note: No check yet distinguishes a far-strike trim from a broken download. Discrimination to prove when built: of the 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-19 dumps it must pass the 10-19 trim (far strikes only, near band intact) and still refuse a dump that loses near-the-money strikes or a whole segment. Unmeasured: how often Kite trims.

occurrences.evidence: 2,179 of 4,064 contracts dropped, far strikes only; reload refused by ADR-058 and ADR-059; every Execute refused until the forced update
